title: The determinant of a flat finitely presented module, defined as the annihilator inside its exterior algebra, is invertible
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a flat module of finite presentation the determinant, defined as the annihilator of the module inside its exterior algebra, is an invertible module (author lemma at source lines 4755-4766, label lemma-determinant-as-socle). The proof (source lines 4768-4799) works locally, splits the module off a finite free module, identifies the module and its determinant with the objects associated to the module of global sections, and transfers the algebraic description of the determinant as an annihilator through the base change to the sections over an open, so that the determinant becomes the pullback of an invertible module (proof lines 4769-4798); the author warns that annihilators may not be computed open by open and records that details are omitted. The reduction to the algebraic statement over the ring of global sections is the content. H3.
